releases.summary: Harden ChordPro parsing for pasted verse text and improve chart-preview diagnostics.
changes: Normalize pasted line endings, Unicode line separators, and a leading byte-order mark before parsing ChordPro.
Add regression tests for the exact verse example {start_of_verse}, [D]Amazing, {end_of_verse} in both the parser and live preview.
Show a concise parser diagnostic if a preview cannot be formatted and keep saved-chart parsing failures on the safe raw-text fallback path.

releases.summary: Make the live chart preview update immediately and harden saved-song chart navigation and fallback rendering.
changes: Parse the bounded live preview directly from the latest editor text instead of waiting for a delayed coroutine state update.
Use a fresh non-restored chart scroll state when opening each saved song to avoid applying a stale list position to a different chart.
Show the original sanitized ChordPro text when a saved chart cannot be formatted, rather than leaving the chart area unusable.
Add unit coverage for immediate preview parsing, empty input, and bounded safe chart fallback text.

releases.summary: Fix saved song charts and live preview, introduce independent team song setlists, and organize account preferences in Settings.
changes: Harden saved ChordPro chart parsing against oversized lines and newline-heavy content while preserving the original saved chart.
Make the Add Song live preview refresh from the current editor text and add a ready-to-insert sample chart with a ChordPro syntax guide.
Create team-shared setlists directly from Songs with at least two songs, add/remove songs, reorder, rename, duplicate, and delete.
Keep setlists independent from dated Services, and retain saved chart snapshots if a library song is later removed.
Add top-bar shortcuts in Chat, Notifications, Settings order; move account, appearance, notification and app-update preferences into Settings.
Add a dedicated Profile overview and persistent System, Light, and Dark appearance choices.

releases.summary: Restore the full workspace layout by keeping bottom navigation at its intended height.
changes: Keep the center Song / Setlist action inside the compact bottom navigation bar instead of allowing its container to expand to the full screen height.
Restore the top app bar and active screen content on the Home, Songs, Services, and Profile destinations.

releases.summary: Safer saved-song charts, simpler navigation, and setlists from Songs.
changes: Harden saved ChordPro chart display by bounding very large charts and extra-long lyric rows. The saved source remains unchanged and shortened display is identified.
Use four core navigation tabs: Home, Songs, Services, and Profile.
Use the large centered Song action to open Add Song, and switch it to Setlist while on Songs.
Create a setlist from Songs and open its editor immediately to add songs.
Open Notifications from the top-right bell instead of the former profile shortcut.
Pull down from the top of Home to refresh; remove the dashboard sync-status card while keeping offline response queues and background synchronization active.

releases.summary: Team Chat unread badges now stay in sync with member read progress.
changes: Clear your private Team Chat alerts through the read cursor, including older messages outside the currently loaded page.
Keep notification clearing scoped to the signed-in member and active organization.

releases.summary: Team Chat now loads conversation history in pages and shows member read receipts.
changes: Load conversation history 50 messages at a time with stable cursor-based pagination, so older messages remain available without downloading the entire chat.
See an unread count on the Team tab, based on private unread Team Chat alerts.
See how many current team members have read each of your messages.
Track read progress by member and message; opening and scrolling through the chat marks visible messages as read and clears only their matching Team Chat notifications.
Keep read-state access scoped to current organization members, with each member able to update only their own read cursor.

releases.summary: Notification read actions now use the correct restricted database permission.
changes: Mark individual or all notifications as read with authenticated access limited to the read_at column and the recipient's own rows.
Load the initial notification list from the Realtime subscription without starting a duplicate database request.
Fall back to a recipient-scoped notification refresh when the Realtime stream cannot be established.

releases.summary: Team Chat keeps your place while you read and supports the keyboard Send action.
changes: Keep your reading position when new team messages arrive; the conversation follows live messages only when you are already near the latest message.
Start with the newest messages when opening a conversation.
Send a message directly from the Android keyboard while keeping the on-screen Send button available.
Keep your draft when a send fails, and avoid reporting a false send failure when only the optional refresh fails.

releases.summary: Notifications now update live and show an unread badge.
changes: Stream your private notifications in real time while UnityHub is open.
See the unread notification count on the existing Notifications tab.
Keep live notification updates restricted to the signed-in recipient through the existing row-level security policies.

releases.summary: Team Chat now notifies the rest of the worship team when a new message arrives.
changes: Create an in-app notification for each new Team Chat message for every other current member of the same organization.
Use the existing Firebase push-delivery pipeline for registered Android devices; message senders are excluded from their own alerts.
Keep message contents out of lock-screen notification previews.
Open Team Chat from an in-app notification or Android push alert, scoped to the notification's organization.

releases.summary: Member profiles bring team roles and participation history together.
changes: Open a team member's read-only profile directly from the Team directory.
Review the member's organization role, membership date, and assigned ministry positions.
See recent service assignments and response statuses without opening each service.
Review rehearsal invitations and recorded attendance, with separate counts for upcoming and completed rehearsals.
Profile activity stays scoped to the active worship team and does not expose email addresses or private response notes.

releases.summary: Introducing the UnityHub in-app update center and a more stable Add Song editor.
changes: UnityHub can check its update service and notify you when a newer version is available.
Download updates from UnityHub storage without opening GitHub or an external download page.
Choose automatic background downloading and review the version tracker and complete release history in Account settings.
Every downloaded package is checked for its expected size, SHA-256 checksum, app identity, version, and signing certificate before Android is asked to install it.
Android displays its own installation confirmation; UnityHub does not silently install or replace the app.
The Add Song ChordPro field now has a controlled height, stable form-item keys, and a live preview that parses in the background after typing pauses.
Large ChordPro drafts are no longer copied into Android's small saved-state bundle.

releases.summary: Service assignment responses now support optional explanations.
changes: Add an optional note of up to 300 characters when marking a service assignment as unable to serve.
Edit a decline note later from the assignment card.
Decline notes are queued with offline responses and synchronized when a connection returns.
Worship leaders can review submitted notes in service assignment lists and the assignment overview.

releases.summary: Manage ministry positions from the Team workspace.
changes: Administrators and worship leaders can add, rename, and delete reusable ministry positions.
Position names are validated for length and duplicate names are checked without regard to letter case.
UnityHub shows how many member profiles use a position before deletion.
